Definition: to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or become light, shine; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to become light (day); 1a2) to shine (of the sun); 1a3) to become bright; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be illuminated; 1b2) to become lighted up; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to give light, shine (of sun, moon, and stars); 1c2) to illumine, light up, cause to shine, shine; 1c3) to kindle, light (candle, wood); 1c4) lighten (of the eyes, his law, etc); 1c5) to make shine (of the face)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
